hero_sub: Sales, support, partnerships, or feedback — we read every message.

faq.question: What's the difference between our plans?
faq.answer: Both plans include the full AuraFlux automated engine. Operate is entirely self-serve via our dashboard and API. Guided integrates our Gemini-backed Collab AI assistant to monitor and refine your outputs. Managed adds dedicated human account managers alongside the AI layer.

faq.question: How do credits work?
faq.answer: Each plan includes a monthly credit allowance. One credit = one complete production job. Unused credits roll over automatically, and Extra Credit Packs can be purchased any time directly inside your account dashboard.

faq.question: Can I connect multiple social accounts?
faq.answer: Yes — connect all major platforms and target any job to one or more simultaneously. YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitch, and Kick are all supported.

faq.question: Do I need technical knowledge?
faq.answer: No. The dashboard guides you through every step. For teams that prefer raw API access, full developer documentation is available at auraflux.co/developer-api.
